data.rationale: Comprehensive code audit found: GoT - 4 critical (cache race, orphan WAL corruption, rollback failure, index inconsistency), 5 high (WAL threading, index perf, LRU perf, edge validation, partial writes). CDG - 4 critical (mutation persistence, history fsync, history ordering, WAL gaps), 4 high (write-set race, incomplete rollback, cleanup masking, TOCTOU). Created sprint S-20260102-170553-db7b9114 with 19 tasks including 2 previously tracked critical bugs.
data.title: Deep dive audit of GoT/CDG identified 17 NEW critical/high bugs not previously tracked
